## Machine Endpoints (for AI agents)

China supplier verification is available as MCP server + x402 pay-per-call. Agents can discover, call and pay autonomously (USDC, Base chain).

| Endpoint | Price | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| verify_supplier | $0.03 | Supplier deep check (registered capital / hiring / related-party risk) |
| landed_cost_calc | $0.02 | Landed cost calculation (tariff / freight / duties) |
| payment_red_flags | $0.01 | Payment method risk scan |
| audit_checklist | $0.01 | 5-layer verification checklist |
| full_supplier_audit | $0.08 | Full due-diligence report with evidence chain |
| certification_check | $0.01 | Certification document verification |

Discovery:
- GET https://lu7897859-tech.github.io/.well-known/mcp.json → MCP server list
- GET https://x402-stable-door.lu7897859.workers.dev/openapi.json → x402 paid endpoints (OpenAPI 3.1)
- Listed in x402scan — search "china supplier verification"
